rationale: A third party (the neighbor's child) suffered a bodily injury (broken wrist) on the policyholder's premises due to the icy condition of the walkway, which falls clearly within liability coverage.
claim_summary: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter suffered a broken wrist after slipping and falling on the policyholder's icy walkway during last week's ice storm. Parents are pursuing medical bills. This is a high-severity pediatric injury on the insured's premises requiring prompt investigation and damage assessment.

case_facts.location: Walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter slipped and fell on icy walkway
